kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Finished cable and harness references for this interface or application.
intro.zh: 此接口或应用方向的成品电缆与线束参考。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: Identify the exact family and termination before selecting cable and protection.
copy.zh: 先识别具体系列及端接方式，再选择线材与防护。

copy.en: Provide mating references, circuit drawing, dimensions and operating conditions.
copy.zh: 提供对插料号、回路图、尺寸及工作条件。

copy.en: Approve materials, samples and the released inspection plan before repeat production.
copy.zh: 重复生产前认可材料、样品及放行检验方案。

copy.en: Identify the mating part number and termination method before confirming the assembly drawing.
copy.zh: 确认对插件料号和端接方式，再确定组件图纸。

copy.en: Compare the sample with the approved pin map, dimensions and material list.
copy.zh: 按确认的针脚对应、尺寸和材料清单审核样品。

copy.en: Retain the approved part list and inspection results for repeat production.
copy.zh: 保留确认物料清单与检验结果，作为重复生产依据。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。

service_label.zh: 可制作兼容替代件、自有原厂采购渠道

reason.en: These references are connectors, wire or process materials; they are not counted as finished terminated assemblies.
reason.zh: 这些编号属于连接器、线材或工艺材料，不计为已端接成品组件。
